fields.statement: Verifier (claude-code-f59ef46b) at abe1e4f8 (attempt 2: fix for the quality finding, adds --full-history to gitUnclaimed). Ran the leaf's acceptance script `go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/check-unclaimed -count=1`: check-unclaimed-commits passes. check --json exits 0 with ok true and exactly 4 warn findings of the unclaimed rule: the no-trailer commit (missing), the unknown-ID commit (unknown change set 01M5ZZZ...), the prose-only commit and the Actor/Leaf-only commit. There are none for the paragraph-before-Co-Authored-By commit, the GitHub-squash-shaped commit, the .rhiza/-only commit, the merge or the pre-cutoff commit. (The acceptance's 'sixth' is a miscount for the fifth, the prose-only commit, as compliance already noted. The statement excludes .rhiza/-only commits.) check-unclaimed-cutoff and the new check-unclaimed-full-history pass. To test the new script, I removed --full-history in a scratch worktree, and it then fails (1 unclaimed match, want 3), so it pins the fix. The diff is the one flag plus a doc comment and the script. make fmt-check passes. make test passes for every package (cmd/rhiza, internal/api, internal/check ...), except the TestReadBudget timing budget, run with load avg ~23 on 4 cores (read path untouched). make self-check fails only on stale .rhiza/rendered actor files from earlier review-run 'record writes' commits. HEAD changes no .rhiza/ file.
